proposed_experiments.description: ADK first-non-None versus notification dispatch and borrowed child close ownership.
Pydantic duplicate exposed tool names/provenance, singleton requires boundary, and per-run instance-reference ordering caveat.
Microsoft indivisible bundle category rejection and deterministic buffered/unbuffered final gate.
Mastra same-ID versus distinct-ID state, and deterministic retry-count oracle.
Eliza missing/cycle diagnostics/returned closure and partial activation/replacement failure cleanup.
Letta overlapping reload completion, exact-owner successor cleanup and pending old invocation cancellation.

inference_limits: Callback/middleware/toolset contracts are not relabeled full artifact plugin Hosts.
Source-visible loops/edges identify potential work, not observed scalability defects.
Hidden model-facing tools do not independently prove permission revocation.
Cleanup return, stream construction and registry removal are not universal physical completion receipts.
Historical repaired incidents remain dated and scoped to their actual implementation lineage.
